info.name: Tecopa Hot Springs & Campground
info.fullAddress: 400 Tecopa Hot Springs Rd., Tecopa, California, 92389
info.campgroundCancellationPolicy: 100% refund until 3 days prior to check-in. 50% percent refund 1 day prior, then the reservation is non-refundable.
info.checkInProcedure: Check in at the park office next to bath houses.

rulesList.name: Dumpsters
rulesList.content: Trash must be disposed in provided dumpsters near bathrooms

rulesList.name: Campfires
rulesList.content: Campfires only in designated fire pits. firewood for sale please ask

alerts:
If you want to book for more than 3 months or you're a big group, please send us an email to admin@tecopahotspringsandcampground.com so we can take of your reservation.

TESAMO members, please contact the campground directly to make your reservation 
We modified our prices and now you can include you Soak and Electric Power to your reservation. You can find them as add-ons while you are creating your reservation. Note: Electric Power option is only available for certain sites.
